NONE: › abbreviation for English for speakers of other languages: used, especially in the UK, to refer to the teaching of English to students whose first language is not English, but who are living in an English-speaking country
作爲外語的英語（教學）（English for speakers of other languages的縮寫）
› very unusual and understood or liked by only a small number of people, especially those with special knowledge
極不尋常的；只有少數人（尤指內行）才懂的；限於小圈子的

example: He has an esoteric collection of old toys and games.
他收藏了一批極罕見的老玩具和遊戲。
disapproving or humorous She has a somewhat esoteric taste in clothes.
她的衣著品味極不尋常。
